newsitem.title: HONG KONG: IDT gets approval for Singapore spinoff.
newsitem.headline: IDT gets approval for Singapore spinoff.

text.p: IDT International Ltd said on Thursday that the Stock Exchange of Singapore had approved in principle the listing of its liquid crystal display consumer electronic products business.

The approval is subject to certain conditions and the proposed listing of the Singapore-incorporated firm, to be named IDT Holdings (Singapore) Ltd, is subject to final approval by the Singapore stock exchange, IDT International said in a statement.
It said the final price for a new issue of IDT Holdings shares would be determined later.
Dealing in IDT Holdings shares on the Singapore stock exchange is expected to begin in the first quarter of 1997.
